name: WPOptimizers – Image Optimizer Lite
author: WPOptimizers

sections.description:
WPOptimizers – Image Optimizer Lite helps you improve your website speed by compressing and optimizing images directly inside your WordPress dashboard. It is built for simplicity, performance, and compatibility.

Features

  • One-click image optimization
  • Support for JPEG, PNG, and GIF images
  • Lightweight and fast – no bloat
  • Optimizes new uploads automatically
  • Reduces file size without visible quality loss

Why choose WPOptimizers Lite?

This plugin is designed for users who want a simple solution to optimize their images without complicated settings or external APIs. Perfect for bloggers, businesses, and developers who care about speed.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/wpoptimizers-image-optimizer-lite directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WPOptimizers from the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Start optimizing your images with one click!
sections.faq:
Does this plugin convert images to WebP?

No, the Lite version only compresses and optimizes existing image formats (JPG, PNG, GIF).

Will this plugin slow down my site?

No. It is lightweight and optimized for performance.

Do I need an API key?

No API key is required. The plugin works out of the box.

Is it free?

Yes! This Lite version is completely free.
